actions.reason: K6_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity: RNA shows coordinated proliferation up-regulation with oxidative-phosphorylation down-regulation, and WXS shows near-universal PBRM1 mutation surviving both driver-panel and global correction. Membership representation is conflicting (WXS positive, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but the K6_C0001–K6_C0003 boundary is positively supported by structural diagnostics (ARI 0.897, within-side affinity 0.442 vs between-side 0.093, low normalized cut 0.361) with weak-but-coherent native-view separation across all four geometries, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. No candidate-specific confounder reaches corrected significance, and no split or merge is supported.

K6_C0002 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows immune/inflammatory depletion with oxidative-phosphorylation enrichment, and WXS shows near-absent VHL mutation surviving both corrections. Set-level membership is weak-to-absent across all modalities, but the K6_C0002–K6_C0005 boundary is positively supported by structural diagnostics (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.502 vs between-side 0.136, intermediate normalized cut 0.455) with weak-but-coherent native-view separation, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. No candidate-specific confounder reaches corrected significance, and no split or merge is supported.

K6_C0003 has a coherent immune-activated transcriptomic identity (interferon gamma/alpha, allograft rejection up-regulation), though WXS mutation enrichment is largely null. Membership representation is conflicting (CT/WSI positive, RNA/WXS negative), but the K6_C0003–K6_C0004 boundary is positively supported by structural diagnostics (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.400 vs between-side 0.122, intermediate normalized cut 0.492) with weak-but-coherent native-view separation, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. Candidate-specific confounder associations (tissue source site, scanner model, z-spacing, slice thickness) remain plausible technical explanations, but the structural boundary evidence and coherent biology support retention as a defensible discovery-stage unit; no split or merge is supported.

K6_C0004 has a coherent immune- and proliferation-depleted transcriptomic identity with TGF-beta up-regulation, though WXS mutation enrichment is null. Set-level membership is weak-to-absent across all modalities, but the K6_C0004–K6_C0006 boundary is positively supported by structural diagnostics (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.493 vs between-side 0.095, low normalized cut 0.331) with weak-but-coherent native-view separation, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. Candidate-specific confounder associations (CT phase, manufacturer, slice thickness, z-spacing) remain plausible technical explanations, but the structural boundary evidence and coherent biology support retention; no split or merge is supported.

K6_C0005 has a coherent immune-activated transcriptomic identity and a multiplicity-robust BAP1 mutation enrichment. Membership representation is weak and partly conflicting (RNA positive, CT/WSI/WXS non-positive), but the K6_C0005–K6_C0006 boundary is positively supported by structural diagnostics (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.590 vs between-side 0.097, lowest normalized cut 0.296) with weak-but-coherent native-view separation, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. Candidate-specific confounder associations (tissue source site, z-spacing, slice thickness) remain plausible technical explanations, but the structural boundary evidence and coherent biology support retention; no split or merge is supported.

K6_C0006 has a coherent mesenchymal/stromal-enriched transcriptomic identity and a VHL-enriched, PBRM1-depleted mutation pattern. Membership representation is strongly conflicting (WXS degenerate positive, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but the K6_C0006–K6_C0005 boundary is positively supported by structural diagnostics (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.590 vs between-side 0.097, lowest normalized cut 0.296) with weak-but-coherent native-view separation, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. No candidate-specific confounder reaches corrected significance, and no split or merge is supported.
